title: Fighting Mastery
description: The late-career counterpart to a fighting style: the same disciplines, taken again at higher level for a stronger set of benefits. It is a content type of its own rather than a second tier inside fighting-style because the two are chosen from separate lists by separate class features, and nothing in the rules requires a character who takes Duelist Mastery to have taken Duelist Style. The naming correspondence between the two lists is real and deliberate, but it is a naming correspondence and not a prerequisite, so it is left as something a reader can see rather than a link this schema asserts.

key.description: Stable slug identifying this fighting mastery. Derived from the name once and never reused, so saved characters keep resolving after a rename.

name.description: Display name, always "<Discipline> Mastery": Duelist Mastery, Great Weapon Mastery, Sharpshooter Mastery. The suffix is kept because it is the only thing distinguishing the entry from the fighting style of the same discipline.

prerequisite.description: What a character must already have to take this mastery, as printed. Only Formfighting Mastery carries one, requiring the ability to cast force powers. Omit when anyone eligible for a mastery may take it.

description.description: The flavour text that opens the entry: one or two sentences in second person saying what the character has mastered, ending at the colon that introduces the benefits. The benefits themselves are not repeated here.

benefits.description: The concrete rules the mastery grants, one entry per bullet as printed, in the printed order. Masteries run to three or four bullets where a style runs to two, which is most of what makes them a later-career choice.

sourceKey.description: Key of the source this fighting mastery was published in, matching a document of the source content type. Every fighting mastery in the archive is phb.

contentSet.description: Whether this fighting mastery belongs to the core rules or to the community expanded-content supplement.
